description: This file defines an Android activity class `TvInstructionsActivity` responsible for displaying TV instructions using a WebView. It manages focus, button interactions, and loads a specific HTML page via a WebView helper. The class includes lifecycle management and UI setup for TV navigation.

classes.name: TvInstructionsActivity
classes.description: An Android activity for displaying instructions via WebView with focus and button handling optimized for TV navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets focus, and loads instruction content into the WebView.

methods.name: prepareTvWebView
methods.description: Configures WebView settings to optimize for TV UI and interaction.

methods.name: continueToNext
methods.description: Handles navigation to the next screen or index, finishing current activity.

methods.name: returnToIndex
methods.description: Navigates back to the index screen.
